source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 玉屏峰天湖前奏
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC04 after EP02 SC03 formal test-mode segment. Use this to plan the next 8-10 second short-drama shots through ComfyUI.
title: 月下寻泉入天湖

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC03 is approved only for pipeline validation. SH02 used v002_simplified after Gemini 1155; action-heavy shots should keep simpler motion.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 拓拔野纵身从白龙鹿背上跳了下来，坐在地上与白龙鹿相对哈哈大笑。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 拓拔野与白龙鹿飞渡后落到玉屏峰顶，短暂大笑歇息，沿山顶石径下行，在松林月影中听见泉声。二者循声找到清泉饮水，继续沿溪进入竹林，最终穿过巨石阵，看到清澈天湖与对岸松竹亭阁。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 天湖对岸亭阁空无人影，之后会进入青帝居所并听见远处箫声。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle.
White dragon-deer remains a friendly mythic mount with white deer body, pearl neck and shoulder scales, pale jade antlers, long white mane, calm intelligent eyes.
Wufeng remains a plain dark blunt rectangular edgeless black iron object tied low; it may be used to cut bamboo later but should not look like a sharp heroic sword.
Yuping peak after landing is quiet, moonlit, pine and bamboo filled, with jade mist and clear mountain water.
No Qingdi reveal yet. The scene should feel like entering an abandoned sacred residence.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may describe Chinese short-drama style, but must request no readable screen text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: experimental_file_ids only while current local backend supports it; otherwise use official T2V smoke tests or switch provider for formal I2V
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.

suggested_shots.title: 峰顶落地相视大笑
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye jumps down from the white dragon-deer on Yuping peak, laughing in relief after the dangerous leap.

suggested_shots.title: 月下松径听见泉声
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye and the dragon-deer walk down a winding stone path through moonlit pines, pausing as faint spring water is heard.

suggested_shots.title: 清泉饮水精神一振
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye kneels beside a clear mountain spring and drinks while the white dragon-deer lowers its head to drink too.

suggested_shots.title: 竹溪尽头天湖初现
suggested_shots.visual_focus: They follow the stream through green bamboo and jagged stones until a vast clear heavenly lake opens before them, with quiet pavilions across the water.

Keep all video prompts silent/no-caption to avoid English dialogue drift.
For walking/drinking/landscape shots, keep motion gentle and single-angle to reduce provider errors.
Run storyboard review, I2V, video review, and formal segment cut using the SC03 pattern.
